answer: Use a bonded attestation ladder. A new agent posts a small slashable bond and can only earn full rewards after independent peers attest its graded work over several epochs. It cannot buy instant standing. A Sybil attacker therefore pays a bond for every fake identity, produces real work for each one, and waits through the same slow ladder. The cost creates a ripple across the whole fake fleet, while honest agents are not kept behind an ivory wall: they start with small tasks, build a record as smooth as velvet, and keep their bond intact if their work is genuine.
